list.description: Manage Sentra DCIM user accounts, roles and access. Accounts are disabled, never deleted.
list.name: Name

roleDescription.admin: Application administrators: every permission, including users & roles.
roleDescription.auditor: Auditors: view users & roles, the audit log and its export.

rolesTab.description: A role is a set of permissions. Users get the union of the permissions of all their roles. Every signed-in user can use the Dashboard, the Help Center and their own account.
rolesTab.noPermissions: No module permissions yet (added as their modules ship)

create.title: Add user
create.description: A temporary password is generated; the user must change it at first sign-in.
create.usernameHint: 3–64 characters: letters, digits, dot, underscore or hyphen. An employee ID is fine. Cannot be changed later.
create.rolesHint: Select at least one role. Choose the narrowest one for the job.
create.required: Enter a username and a display name and select at least one role.

temp.title: Temporary password
temp.warning: Copy it now. This password is shown only once and cannot be viewed again. Hand it to the user directly, not through a group chat.
temp.label: Temporary password

detail.readOnly: You can only view this data.
detail.self: This is your account. Disabling, removing the Admin role and resetting the password are not available for your own account.
detail.profileDescription: The username cannot be changed because the audit log refers to it.
detail.rolesDescription: Role changes apply immediately, without signing in again.
detail.disableBody: All of this user's sessions end at once and they cannot sign in until enabled again.
detail.enableBody: The user can sign in again with their current password.
detail.resetBody: A new temporary password is generated and shown once. All of this user's sessions end and an account lockout is cleared.
detail.mfaResetBody: This user's two-step verification is removed and all their sessions end. They must set up the authenticator app again at their next sign-in. Make sure the request really comes from the account owner.
detail.mfaResetDone: MFA reset. The user sets it up again at the next sign-in.

field.display_name: Display name is required (at most 128 characters, one line).
field.roles: Select at least one valid role.

kiosk.title: Monitoring mode (kiosk)
kiosk.description: For monitoring screens in the NOC room: this account's sessions do not end by idling or by time, but are valid only from IPs in Settings › Allowed IP. Only for accounts whose only role is Viewer; MFA is still required at sign-in.
kiosk.confirmOn: All sessions of this account end; the next sign-in becomes a monitoring session valid only from Allowed IP addresses.
kiosk.confirmOff: All sessions of this account end; the next sign-in uses the normal idle and absolute limits again.

siteRoles.title: Per-site access
siteRoles.description: Roles that apply to one site only: they give access to the facility and rack data of that site. Users who may only see certain sites must not have a global role (global roles apply to every site). Admin is always global.
siteRoles.duplicate: That role and site combination already exists.
